async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Byte Blaze' link to expand the user menu
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Byte Blaze', expanded=False).click()
    # Wait for the menu to expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Edit status' button in the expanded menu
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Edit status').click()
    # Wait for the status dialog to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Fill the status textbox with 'Resting due to leg injury'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name="What's your status?").fill('Resting due to leg injury')
    # Click the Close button to save and close the dialog
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Close').click()
    # Wait for any UI updates
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
